name: B10-0277/2025 – After § 6 – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 6a. Calls for all public funding under the Clean Industrial Deal and related instruments to be underpinned by binding social conditionalities, ensuring that public support is strictly conditional on enforceable job guarantees, respect for collective bargaining and collective agreements, decent wages, secure employment, and high-quality working conditions; underlines that such conditionalities are essential to ensure that the clean industrial transition creates quality jobs across Europe and does not lead to the growth of territorial and social divergences; stresses that companies benefiting from public support must actively engage in social dialogue and uphold fundamental workers’ rights;
